description: Return when the specified service is healthy, or timeout after 60 seconds

service.description: What service to check. For example: all, pe-master, orchestrator-service. 'all' queries the simple aggregate status of whatever process is listening on the given port -- it isn't specific to puppetserver, it just means 'everything registered on this port'.

port.description: Which port to query the status API on: 8140 puppetserver, 8143 orchestration-services, 4433 console-services, 8081 puppetdb
